tests.name: lexer_literal_true_valid
tests.intent: Probes scanning of the literal true via contiguous input fast path.

tests.name: lexer_literal_false_valid
tests.intent: Probes scanning of the literal false via contiguous input fast path.

tests.name: lexer_literal_null_valid
tests.intent: Probes scanning of the literal null via contiguous input fast path.

tests.name: lexer_literal_true_truncation
tests.intent: Probes lexer error handling when the true literal is truncated.

tests.name: lexer_literal_false_mismatch
tests.intent: Probes lexer fallback and error reporting on a corrupted false literal.

tests.name: lexer_literal_null_mismatch
tests.intent: Probes lexer fallback and error reporting on a misspelled null literal.

tests.name: parser_states_deep_array_nesting
tests.intent: Probes parser stack management of array nesting states stored as bytes.

tests.name: parser_states_deep_object_nesting
tests.intent: Probes parser stack management of object nesting states stored as bytes.

tests.name: parser_states_mixed_nesting
tests.intent: Probes alternating array and object nesting parsing states.

tests.name: stream_bulk_scan_literals_array
tests.intent: Probes bulk stream scanning with multiple literals inside an array.

tests.name: stream_bulk_scan_error_position
tests.intent: Probes error reporting position when a stream literal fails after bulk check.

tests.name: sax_parse_literals
tests.intent: Probes SAX interface parsing behavior for all three literal tokens.

tests.name: accept_literals_sequence
tests.intent: Probes the accept() method with a sequence of mixed literals.

tests.name: span_adapter_literals
tests.intent: Probes span_input_adapter parsing with contiguous literal inputs.

tests.name: parser_mismatched_brackets
tests.intent: Probes parser error detection when states vector encounters mismatched brackets.

tests.name: parser_extra_closing_bracket
tests.intent: Probes parser failure when an extra closing bracket is encountered.

tests.name: parser_unclosed_array
tests.intent: Probes parser error behavior when an array is left unclosed.

tests.name: parser_unclosed_object
tests.intent: Probes parser error behavior when an object is left unclosed.

tests.name: lexer_literal_case_sensitivity
tests.intent: Probes case-sensitivity checking in lexer scan_literal via uppercase input letters.

tests.name: parser_empty_containers_states
tests.intent: Probes parser handling of empty nested objects and arrays.
